transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I came in because I've had this really sudden shift in how much I'm doing. I went from barely settling into my new apartment to suddenly... I don't know, just taking on way too much all at once. 

I started saying yes to all these mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes for work, and I even started completely redesigning my whole portfolio. It was just like I had to fix my entire life in one giant sprint, and I realized it's getting to be a bit much.
How long has this unusually driven, high-activity period been going on?
It's been about a month. This whole intense up-and-down pattern basically started right around the time I moved into the apartment.
During this high-activity period, have you needed less sleep than usual without feeling tired?

Yeah, actually. Um, for several nights I was only getting maybe three or four hours of sleep. The weird part was I didn't feel tired at all. I would wake up convinced I was totally fine, and I just figured I should use the extra time in the morning to get ahead on all the work I was doing.
During this period of increased activity and reduced sleep, have you felt unusually euphoric or unusually irritable compared with your normal mood?

Yeah, both, actually. Earlier this month I felt... almost electric, just really upbeat one minute. But then I'd get incredibly frustrated the next. I ended up snapping at a contractor for work, and even my sister, over just tiny delays. I don't know, it just felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done.
How much has this period interfered with your work, relationships, or daily functioning?

It's definitely had an impact. I actually missed an important design review at work because I was just so all over the place. And... honestly, I've kind of been avoiding my friends and family lately. I just feel really embarrassed about how scattered and, I don't know, unreliable I've seemed to everyone.
Before this month, have you ever had another distinct period when you felt unusually energized or irritable and needed much less sleep?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I was busy or maybe a little stressed with a project, but nothing like this. This month has just been... different. I really can't remember ever feeling this wired or needing this little sleep before.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt persistently depressed or lost interest in most activities?

Yeah, I have. Actually, lately I've been dealing with that a lot. I'll wake up with this... just a really heavy, gray feeling in my chest. And even when the apartment is totally quiet and nothing bad is actually happening, I just... I feel like I could cry over a coffee mug left in the sink. It just stays with me like that for weeks.
Have the heavy, gray feelings and urges to cry been happening during the same period as your increased energy and reduced need for sleep?

No... no, they haven't been happening at the same time. Um, when I have those heavy, sad periods, I'm definitely not energized. It's pretty much the exact opposite. The really wired feeling where I don't need to sleep... that's just been recently, like this past month. The crying and feeling gray was before all of this started. So, yeah, they feel like completely separate things.
Did this high-energy period make you unable to carry out your usual work or daily responsibilities?

Yeah, it has. Um, I actually missed a design review for work recently. And outside of work... I've been avoiding my friends and family. I just feel really embarrassed about how scattered and unreliable I've seemed to everyone lately. So, yeah, it's definitely been getting in the way of my normal responsibilities.
